+#!/bin/zsh
+# 把素材目录里的图片缩成缩略图 → build/thumbs/<name>.png
+# 用法: tools/make_thumbs.sh A [B ...]
+set -e
+ROOT=${0:A:h:h}
+for name in "$@"; do
+  work="$ROOT/.cache/thumbs/$name"
+  out="$ROOT/build/thumbs/$name.png"
+  [[ -f "$out" ]] && { echo "skip $name"; continue; }
+  rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
+  echo "[$name] resizing $(date +%T)"
+  magick "$ROOT/assets/images/$name.png" -resize 256x256 -strip "$work/thumb.png"
+  echo "[$name] optimizing $(date +%T)"
+  "$ROOT/tools/optimize" "$work/thumb.png" 2 "$out"
+  rm -rf "$work"
+  echo "[$name] done $(date +%T)"
+done
